tests: decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair required context module file and byte budgets refuse before dispatch
decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair reuses a patch slot after restoring the first file
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair required context module file and byte budgets refuse before dispatch' --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair reuses a patch slot after restoring the first file'

scope.claim: The active repair loop independently refuses (1) two required modules under maximumContextModules=1, with both module owners seeded; (2) two required files under maximumContextFiles=1 while the byte ceiling exactly fits; and (3) a two-file required context whose bytes exceed maximumContextBytes by one while module/file ceilings have headroom. Each case refuses before harness dispatch, preserves accepted source/head, leaves no pending attempt, and records RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. The run also includes the active ACP patch-slot reuse case.
limitations: Context admissions use a strict captured test harness and do not launch ACP after pre-dispatch refusal.
Local evidence only; no live provider, successful production validation under #236, other profiles, hosted exact-head CI, or complete #734/#63 acceptance.
